sentences.text: Aluminium or aluminum -LRB- see below -RRB- is a chemical element in the boron group with symbol Al and atomic number 13 .	below	Aluminium#Different endings	chemical element	chemical element	boron group	boron group	atomic number	atomic number
It is a silvery-white , soft , nonmagnetic , ductile metal .	ductile	ductility	metal	metal

By mass , aluminium makes up about 8 % of the Earth 's crust ; it is the third most abundant element after oxygen and silicon and the most abundant metal in the crust , though it is less common in the mantle below .	below	Aluminium#Different endings	metal	metal	oxygen	oxygen	silicon	silicon
Aluminium metal is so chemically reactive that native specimens are rare and limited to extreme reducing environments .	metal	metal	native specimens	Native metal	reducing	Redox
Instead , it is found combined in over 270 different minerals .
The chief ore of aluminium is bauxite .	ore	ore	bauxite	bauxite

Aluminium is remarkable for the metal 's low density and its ability to resist corrosion through the phenomenon of passivation .	metal	metal	density	density	corrosion	corrosion	passivation	passivation (chemistry)
Aluminium and its alloys are vital to the aerospace industry and important in transportation and structures , such as building facades and window frames .	alloys	aluminium alloy	aerospace	aerospace
The oxides and sulfates are the most useful compounds of aluminium .	oxides	oxides	sulfates	sulfates

Despite its prevalence in the environment , no known form of life uses aluminium salts metabolically , but aluminium is well tolerated by plants and animals .	salts	Salt (chemistry)	metabolically	metabolically
Because of these salts ' abundance , the potential for a biological role for them is of continuing interest , and studies continue .	salts	Salt (chemistry)
